verdict.rationale: PostHog ships several background-automation primitives: CDP pipelines/Hog functions that run in realtime or on a schedule (posthog-docs-18, posthog-docs-28), 'workflows that automate actions or send messages' (posthog-gh-7), automatic feature-flag rollouts/kill-switches (posthog-docs-5), and autonomous PR generation from detected signals like errors/rage clicks (posthog-gh-1, posthog-docs-32). These are documented as running without manual triggering each time, fitting the autonomous-background-automation story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these automations run reliably unattended over time, and more detail on scheduling/cron granularity for CDP pipelines.
